source_version: The public file listing had one data.csv file; Kaggle CLI metadata did not expose a version number.

raw_audit.time_resolution: whole seconds; timestamps commonly repeat for 20 rows, with the next timestamp +2 seconds

timestamp_aware_extraction.assumption: Sensor rows within each whole-second timestamp bucket retain sample order; the published 10 Hz rate and bucket row counts are used to detect incomplete/gapped blocks. Sub-second timing cannot be verified from this source file.
timestamp_aware_extraction.note: Data preprocessing audit only. The 2026-10-22 Kaggle v3 run used the prior invalid subsecond timestamp assumption and failed before producing model metrics. A corrected Kaggle run has not yet been completed.
